name: Aku'mai's Lair
summary: Beyond the Moonshrine Sanctum, Aku'mai's Lair lies beneath Blackfathom Deeps. In its flooded depths, cultists and naga gather around Aku'mai, a hydra they honor as a servant of the Old Gods.

sections.title: Heart of the Depths
sections.body: Four braziers flank a naga statue behind the Moonshrine Sanctum's sealed double doors. Lighting them awakens guardians sworn to defend the threshold. Beyond the doors, a sunless grotto lies beneath the water. Twilight's Hammer cultists and invading naga gather there in reverence of Aku'mai, an ancient, three-headed hydra they consider a living servant of the Old Gods.

sections.title: Harbinger of Ruin
sections.body: Twilight's Hammer cultists see Aku'mai as an omen of a promised age of darkness. They believe the beast's emergence and continued sustenance will herald the breaking of subterranean prisons holding their ancient deities. Sacrificial offerings feed Aku'mai, while dark magic guards the pool where it dwells. The cult's plans center on this beast as ancient evil claws its way back into Kalimdor.

aliases: how to get to akumai room
faq.answer: Aku'mai's Lair lies at the end of the Blackfathom Deeps cavern complex in Ashenvale, beyond the sealed doors of the Moonshrine Sanctum.

faq.q: How do you open the doors to Aku'mai's Lair?
faq.answer: Light the four ritual braziers around the naga statue in the Moonshrine Sanctum, then defeat the creatures summoned to guard them. The double doors into Aku'mai's Lair will open.
Aku'mai, a massive, three-headed hydra tainted by ancient dark powers, dwells in the cavern as a servant of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer cult worshiping here?
faq.answer: Twilight's Hammer cultists revere Aku'mai as a servant of the Old Gods. They believe empowering the beast will help restore the age when the Old Gods ruled the world.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see a desecrated temple of Elune turned into a foul nest for an Old God spawn. Such defilement of Ashenvale's sacred soil is intolerable.
As a druid, you see Aku'mai's watery den as a severe blight on Kalimdor's waterways and beasts. Its vile mutation and unnatural corruption spread through the depths.
